import json, os, subprocess, shutil, pathlib

OUT = pathlib.Path("/work/out"); OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
RUNS = [
    ("medium", 20260101), ("medium", 20260202),   # independent replicates
    ("easy",   None),     ("hard",   None),       # other tiers
]
summary = []
for tier, seed in RUNS:
    cmd = ["python", "-m", "smartscan.cli", "train", "--what", "predictor",
           "--config", f"configs/{tier}.yaml", "--arch", "transformer",
           "--episodes", "300", "--windows-per-episode", "200"]
    if seed:
        cmd += ["--set", f"run.seed={seed}"]
    print("\n>>>", " ".join(cmd), flush=True)
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print(r.stdout[-1500:] or r.stderr[-1500:], flush=True)

    h = pathlib.Path(f"runs/checkpoints/predictor_{tier}_history.json")
    if h.is_file():
        s = json.loads(h.read_text())["scores_vs_truth"]
        summary.append((tier, seed, s["auc"], s["average_precision"]))
        # Tag by seed so a later run cannot overwrite an earlier result.
        tag = f"{tier}_{seed or 'default'}"
        shutil.copy(h, OUT / f"hist_{tag}.json")
        pt = pathlib.Path(f"runs/checkpoints/predictor_{tier}.pt")
        if pt.is_file():
            shutil.copy(pt, OUT / f"predictor_{tag}.pt")

for tier in ("medium", "easy", "hard"):
    subprocess.run(["python", "-m", "smartscan.cli", "export-onnx",
                    "--config", f"configs/{tier}.yaml"], capture_output=True)
if os.path.isdir("runs/onnx"):
    shutil.copytree("runs/onnx", OUT / "onnx", dirs_exist_ok=True)

SHIPPED = {"medium": 0.683, "easy": 0.911, "hard": 0.673}
print(f"\n{'tier':8s} {'seed':>10s} {'AUC':>7s} {'AP':>7s} {'vs shipped':>11s}")
for tier, seed, auc, ap in summary:
    print(f"{tier:8s} {str(seed or '-'):>10s} {auc:7.4f} {ap:7.4f} "
          f"{auc - SHIPPED[tier]:+11.3f}")
print("\nnoise floor sd 0.038 — a delta under +0.08 is not a result")
print("files in /work/out:", sorted(p.name for p in OUT.iterdir()))

# Run-to-run spread at the SHIPPED recipe (300 episodes x 200 windows).
# WHY: the shipped predictors use --episodes 300 --windows-per-episode 200, but
# no spread has ever been measured AT that recipe. The only published spread
# (sd 0.038) comes from 31x400, ~10x smaller, so it cannot judge these runs.
#
# Training episodes are range(run.seed+1000, run.seed+1000+episodes), so two
# seeds are independent only if they differ by >= 300. The earlier pair
# 20260101/20260202 differ by 101 and therefore SHARE 199 of 300 episodes --
# they are not the independent replicates they were labelled as. The four below
# are spaced 400 apart, and are disjoint from each other and from both earlier
# runs.
!pip install -q "smartscan[ml,viz] @ git+https://github.com/shirish-raj-gupta/SpectraX_Anveshak_SIH26055_Prototype.git" onnx onnxruntime onnxscript

import json, pathlib, subprocess, shutil, statistics

OUT = pathlib.Path("/work/out"); OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
SEEDS = [20260600, 20261300, 20261700, 20262100]
EPISODES, WPE, TIER = 300, 200, "medium"

rows = []
for seed in SEEDS:
    cmd = ["python", "-m", "smartscan.cli", "train", "--what", "predictor",
           "--config", f"configs/{TIER}.yaml", "--arch", "transformer",
           "--episodes", str(EPISODES), "--windows-per-episode", str(WPE),
           "--set", f"run.seed={seed}"]
    print("\n>>>", " ".join(cmd), flush=True)
    r = subprocess.run(cmd, capture_output=True, text=True)
    print((r.stdout or r.stderr)[-1200:], flush=True)

    h = pathlib.Path(f"runs/checkpoints/predictor_{TIER}_history.json")
    if h.is_file():
        d = json.loads(h.read_text()); s = d["scores_vs_truth"]
        rows.append((seed, s["auc"], s["average_precision"], d["best_val_loss"]))
        shutil.copy(h, OUT / f"spread_{TIER}_{seed}.json")
    else:
        print(f"!! no history for seed {seed}", flush=True)

# Combine with the two EARLIER draws that are genuinely disjoint from these and
# from each other. 20260202 is excluded on purpose: 66% shared with 20260101.
PRIOR = [(20260902, 0.7634), (20260101, 0.7627)]
aucs = [a for _, a, _, _ in rows] + [a for _, a in PRIOR]

print(f"\n{'seed':>10s} {'AUC':>8s} {'AP':>8s} {'val_loss':>10s}")
for seed, auc, ap, vl in rows:
    print(f"{seed:>10d} {auc:8.4f} {ap:8.4f} {vl:10.6f}")
for seed, auc in PRIOR:
    print(f"{seed:>10d} {auc:8.4f} {'(prior)':>8s} {'-':>10s}")

if len(aucs) > 1:
    m, sd = statistics.mean(aucs), statistics.stdev(aucs)
    print(f"\nn={len(aucs)} independent draws at {EPISODES}x{WPE}")
    print(f"  mean AUC {m:.4f}   sd {sd:.4f}")
    print(f"  bar at this recipe: {2*sd:.4f}  (the 31x400 recipe's was 0.076)")
    print(f"  incumbent 0.683 -> mean {m:.4f} = {m-0.683:+.4f}")
    print(f"  VERDICT: {'clears' if (m-0.683) > 2*sd else 'DOES NOT clear'} the bar")
print("\nfiles:", sorted(p.name for p in OUT.iterdir()))
